title: Can Blockchain Technology Help Overcome Contractual Incompleteness? Evidence from State Laws
eligible_reason: The coefficient of interest in every main table is on asi_has_pos_pass3yr = Post Treat x ASI, a continuous asset-specificity moderator interacted with the post-law indicator (triple-difference / treatment-intensity design). All regressions also include the continuous time-varying ASI, Treat x ASI, and seven time-varying firm and industry controls (size, ROA, cash, sales, HHI, industry intangibles, industry R&D). The binary Post Treat indicator (has_pos_pass3yr) also switches off after three years for 222 firms. Figure 1 is a stacked (law-by-law, 16 laws) event study with the triple interaction. No specification satisfies PROTOCOL.md Section 2.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 2011-2021 (37,864 firm-years, 6,359 firms; Maintest_tables2to7A.dta). Treatment: staggered state pro-blockchain laws. has_pos_pass3yr (Post Treat) = 1 in the three years after the firm's state passes a law; first switch-on years 2016 (181 firms), 2017 (730), 2018 (512), 2019 (450), 2020 (121), 2021 (21); 4,344 firms never treated; 222 firms switch back off (3-year window). treat3yr_asi = time-invariant treated indicator x ASI (2,015 treated firms). The paper's estimand is the differential effect by asset specificity: coefficient on asi_has_pos_pass3yr. Specification: reghdfe y asi_has_pos_pass3yr has_pos_pass3yr treat3yr_asi asi $control, absorb(firmid clyear) cl(firmid). Outcomes: Tobin's Q (2 measures, yearly and quarterly), R&D intensity, patents, blockchain patents, patent value/generality, vertical integration, M&A counts, alliance counts and CARs, supplier-customer geographic proximity (supplier level and pair level with firmid_sp firmid_cnms clyear FE). A plain binary DiD on has_pos_pass3yr is not reported anywhere as a stand-alone specification.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Six distinct first switch-on years of has_pos_pass3yr (2016-2021) inferred from the data; the state identifier is not in the package. Figure 1 sample stacks 16 separate laws (law_index 1-16).

software_notes: Stata 14.2/16/18; reghdfe, outreg2, estout, coefplot. Firm IDs anonymized (CRSP/Compustat, Compustat segments, Data Axle licensed); no state identifier or law-date variable included.
priority_note: Not eligible: the design is a continuous-moderator triple difference with time-varying controls; a binary-only TWFE on has_pos_pass3yr is not a published specification and could not be matched to a reported estimate.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Variable mapping from readme.pdf: asi_has_pos_pass3yr = Post Treat x ASI, has_pos_pass3yr = Post Treat, treat3yr_asi = Treat x ASI. Data checks: asi_has_pos_pass3yr equals asi x has_pos_pass3yr exactly; ASI varies within firm over time (5,556 firms). Post indicator spells last 1-6 years (mean 3.3), consistent with a 3-year post window plus multiple laws per state.
